clue.text: Tom heading East to find goddess

indicators.note: the tom is heading the East, going in front of it in the line

parts.note: a tom is a male cat, a he-cat

explanation.surface: A tomcat sets off eastward in search of a deity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading' looks like travel but puts the tom in front of E.
explanation.definitionFit: Hecate is the Greek deity of witchcraft and crossroads.

clue.text: Greeting sailor's act of piracy

parts.note: hi is an informal hello
a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A seaman waving hello turns out to be a pirate.
explanation.definitionFit: Hijacking is the seizure of a vessel or vehicle by force.

clue.text: Search for way to throw a fight

parts.note: to cast is to throw
a bout is a boxing match

explanation.surface: Looking for a way to lose a boxing match on purpose.
explanation.definitionFit: To cast about is to look around in search of a means or plan.

clue.text: Examine a protective coat

parts.note: to test is to examine

explanation.surface: Inspect a coat for safety.
explanation.definitionFit: In botany the testa is the hard outer layer of a seed.

clue.text: Wide range of crumpets cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters of crumpets are worked over into a new form

explanation.surface: A broad selection of crumpets has been toasted.
explanation.definitionFit: A spectrum is a full sweep of variation from one extreme to the other.

clue.text: First of patients agreed to be given a jab

indicators.note: first of takes the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: OK'd is agreed or approved

explanation.surface: The first patient consented to an injection.
explanation.definitionFit: Poked means prodded, struck with a jab of the finger or a stick.

clue.text: Claim this arrangement is way to control budget

indicators.note: an arrangement of the words before it means their letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone asserts this plan will keep spending in check.
explanation.definitionFit: A cash limit is a fixed ceiling on spending set for a department.

clue.text: Open up headless fish

indicators.note: headless means the word loses its first letter

parts.note: to broach is to open, as a cask or a subject

explanation.surface: Gut a fish whose head has been cut off.
explanation.definitionFit: The roach is a common European freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Parts of motorway followed by East European citizen

indicators.note: followed by puts the compass point after everything before it

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north–south motorway, written MI in crosswords
lanes are the parallel parts of a carriageway

explanation.surface: Lanes of a motorway lead to someone from Eastern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: A Milanese is a native or resident of Milan in Italy.

clue.text: After six runs is dismissed, upsetting top players

indicators.note: after says the remaining letters follow the opening six and runs

parts.note: VI is six in Roman numerals
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

indicators.note: in a down clue upsetting turns the following words upside down, reading them backwards

parts.note: a batsman dismissed in cricket is out

explanation.surface: A cricketer out after scoring six runs upsets the star team.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'upsetting' turns the cricket phrase for being dismissed upside down, so it reads from the bottom; 'top players' is the definition, not a cricket team.
explanation.definitionFit: Virtuosi are performers of outstanding technical skill.

clue.text: Incense little woman with three sons a moment after

indicators.note: after places the moment behind the woman and her sons

parts.note: Jo March is a heroine of the novel Little Women
S is the abbreviation for son, three times over
a tick is a very short time, as in 'just a tick'

explanation.surface: A young woman arrives with her three boys shortly afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A joss stick is a stick of fragrant material burnt as an offering.

clue.text: Author left cover

parts.note: George Bernard Shaw, the Irish playwright

explanation.surface: A writer abandoned his protection.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrap of fabric worn round the shoulders covers the wearer.

clue.text: Be inclined to muffle beat that's noisy

indicators.note: to muffle something is to wrap round it, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: to cant is to tilt or slope
to lam is to thrash

explanation.surface: Someone tends to dampen a loud rhythm.
explanation.definitionFit: Clamant is a literary word for clamorous, insistently loud.

clue.text: Sea creature found where boat may be moored

definitions.meaning: a small toothed whale of the seas
a mooring post or buoy in a harbour also carries this name

explanation.definitionFit: The marine mammal and a harbour mooring post share one name.

clue.text: Peerless debating chamber

parts.note: peerless here means with no peers, the lower debating house of Parliament where no lords sit

explanation.definitionFit: The elected UK chamber has no hereditary or life peers, unlike the Lords.

clue.text: Thus reduced his time for game of cards

parts.note: so means thus
reduced prices are low

explanation.surface: So he cut down the hours he spent playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: Solo whist is a whist variant in which one player may play alone against the others.

clue.text: Church manse's rebuilt for bishop, possibly

indicators.note: rebuilt means the letters of the word are put together again differently

explanation.surface: A church house has been reconstructed for a clergyman.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of manse's counts as a letter of the fodder here.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop is one of the pieces in chess, an example of the category.

clue.text: Not many are involved in this, as a rule

definitions.text: Not many are involved in this, as a rule

parts.words: Not many are involved in this, as a rule
parts.note: as a rule means usually, but here it means in a form of rule or government in which only a few people share power

explanation.definitionFit: Oligarchy is government by a small group of people.

clue.text: What tourists do in one spot after another

indicators.note: after puts the second spotting word behind the first

parts.note: to sight something is to spot it
another spot word: to see is to spot

explanation.surface: Tourists go from one place to the next.
explanation.definitionFit: To sightsee is to visit places of interest as a tourist.

clue.text: Group that may be produced by listing an elite

indicators.note: says the group can be made out of the letters of the following words once rearranged

explanation.surface: A clique could emerge from drawing up a list of the elite.
explanation.definitionFit: The intelligentsia is the class of intellectuals in a society.

clue.text: One who morally judges, say, this smoker in church

indicators.note: say signals that the word is to be spoken, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: a censor judges what is morally fit to publish

explanation.surface: A moral judge is compared to something that fumes in church.
explanation.definitionFit: A censer is a vessel in which incense is burnt during services, so it gives off smoke.

clue.text: Fool jester's doubled up?

parts.note: something doubled up is folded in half
a wit is a joker, a jester; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: A clown is bent over, perhaps with laughter.
explanation.definitionFit: A halfwit is a stupid person, a dimwit.

clue.text: Save a place for the rest of the drivers

definitions.text: a place for the rest of the drivers
definitions.meaning: a roadside parking area where drivers can stop to rest

explanation.definitionFit: The verb meaning store up and the British roadside stopping place share one spelling.

clue.text: Opera to study — there's no end to it

indicators.note: no end to it means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: to scan is to study closely

explanation.surface: An opera that seems to go on endlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Tosca is Puccini's opera of 1900.

clue.text: Recover pound pinched by lout

indicators.note: pinched by means held tight inside the other piece

parts.note: a savage is a brutal, uncouth person
L is the abbreviation for a pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Getting back money stolen by a thug.
explanation.definitionFit: To salvage is to rescue or retrieve something from loss.

clue.text: Print showing burning house

parts.note: lit means alight, burning

explanation.surface: A picture of a blazing building.
explanation.definitionFit: Litho is short for lithograph, a print made from a flat stone or metal plate.

clue.text: Old writers found in dusty libraries

indicators.note: found in says the letters sit within the next words

explanation.surface: Ancient authors turn up in dusty book collections.
explanation.definitionFit: Styli were the pointed instruments once used for writing on wax tablets.

clue.text: Revolting slave in old city caught by us

parts.note: Sparta was a city-state of ancient Greece
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: A rebellious slave in an ancient city is captured by our side.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartacus was a Thracian gladiator who led a slave uprising against Rome.

clue.text: Fix a typing error initially in this language

indicators.note: initially picks out the first letter of the next word
fix suggests putting the following letters right by rearranging them

explanation.surface: Correct a misprint in a language.
explanation.definitionFit: Egyptian is the ancient tongue of the pharaohs, written in hieroglyphs.

clue.text: He is patronised by those who pull the strings

definitions.text: He is patronised by those who pull the strings

parts.words: He is patronised by those who pull the strings
parts.note: pulling strings suggests wielding influence, but here the strings are bowstrings drawn by archers, the customers of a craftsman

explanation.definitionFit: A bowyer makes bows, so archers who draw bowstrings are his customers.
